_doc: ECS test-harness KNOBS -- the SINGLE VISIBLE place for every tunable (so no important knob is buried in mutmut internals or scattered across shell scripts). Read by tests/harness/{gate,mutation}.py and the spark runner. Every knob is ENV-OVERRIDABLE (the env var is in '_env'); a per-owner registry (tests/_support/*_coverage_targets.json) may override any mutation_gate / gpu_pool knob via its own top-level 'harness' block (e.g. an expensive-dynamics batch raising the mutation timeout). Precedence: env > registry 'harness' > this file.

coverage_gate._note: L0 gate = 100% statement + 100% branch per unit (minus NAMED exemptions) + AST public-unit reconcile + out_of_scope anti-lie. Hypothesis seed is PINNED (deterministic green -- kills the example-DB flaky false-green class).

mutation_gate._note: L2 gate: kill_rate = killed/total >= kill_rate_bar. jobs=null -> 4 workers for the CUDA-hidden CPU lane and 1 fresh worker for the GPU-serial lane. A GPU registry may explicitly select 1..4 fresh pytest workers sharing exactly one leased, pinned device; restricted-MPS GPU shards select 4, while shards remain sequential. Four-way admission requires four overlapping clean process calls before fixed mutant waves. Each child has one host thread, unique log/sentinel/basetemp, no inherited pytest/xdist expansion, and read-only generated inputs. Checkpoints bind the sanitized environment plus GPU UUID/driver; host/CUDA resource exhaustion cancels siblings and is never killed evidence. mutmut's per-mutant WALL timeout = (estimated_test_time + timeout_constant) * timeout_multiplier (mutmut default 15x). RAISE timeout_multiplier for EXPENSIVE-DYNAMICS batches so slow-but-FINITE mutants run to completion and get KILLED by the wrong-value assert instead of being cut off as a timeout (a timeout counts as not-killed). Truly-hanging mutants still time out (correct). skip_slow -> tests marked @pytest.mark.skipif(os.environ.get('ECS_MUTATION_SKIP_SLOW')=='1') are skipped UNDER MUTATION ONLY (they are slow physics-convergence pins that do not discriminate mutants; the fast pins kill them). The gate runs them for physics correctness. Do NOT skip-slow a test that IS the discriminator (e.g. memwitness witness tests -- raise the timeout instead).

gpu_pool._note: pool_size=null -> auto-detect (nvidia-smi -L, fallback 1). N GPUs -> up to N GPU jobs run in parallel, each pinned to its own CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; 1 GPU -> serialize. Only registries with requires_gpu=true acquire a slot (CPU-pure batches stay fully parallel).

service_acceptance._note: Every catalog acceptance file runs in a fresh exec process. cpu_light is bounded by cpu_light_jobs, CPU count, and a MemAvailable admission cap; memory/BLAS-heavy files are cpu_exclusive; native CUDA files are gpu_serial under one cross-process lease. Fresh processes reset unrelated Torch, QuTiP/cuQuantum/CuPy, fused-extension, and CUDA-Q allocator/lifetime state without changing scientific tolerances.
